chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Yazid ibn Khalifah, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The time of fajr is from when it appears until it becomes bright.

key_terms.وَقْتُ: the appointed time or prescribed period
key_terms.يَبْدُو: it first appears or becomes visible
key_terms.ٱلْفَجْرِ: dawn; the beginning time of the fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of salat al-fajr begin and end?
ai.summary: This hadith states the time for salat al-fajr begins when dawn first appears and continues until the sky becomes bright. It serves as a jurisprudential indication of the valid prayer window for fajr in Shia fiqh.
